info.title: Nyaykosh API
info.description: Open-access API for Indian laws + compliance simulator (Nyaykosh).

Compliance personas tied to an Act: simulator personas linked via
``lawId`` plus any personas parsed from the Act's AKN XML.

schema.title: Response Get Law Personas V1 Laws  Slug  Personas Get

get.description:
Serve the law as an Akoma Ntoso (LegalDocML) XML document. Powers the
"Structured XML" download.

If the act was imported from XML, the exact uploaded source document is
returned (so download == upload, round-trippable). Otherwise the XML is
generated on the fly from the stored provisions and penalties.

Generate a reference PDF of the law (title, provisions, penalties) built
from the stored data. Powers the "Official PDF" download.

post.description: Evaluate the rules of one persona+trigger against checked checklist items.

get.description:
Rules made under an act (mirrors the admin act-detail Rules tab). Powers
the public law page's "Rules & Subordinate Legislation" section.

schema.title: Response Get Act Rules V1 Public Acts  Act Id  Rules Get
Response List Personas V1 Admin Personas Get
Response Replace Personas V1 Admin Personas Put

post.description:
Parse + merge an uploaded .xlsx WITHOUT persisting — for a dry-run preview.

Pass ``lawId`` to associate the imported rules with a specific act.

Parse, merge, and PERSIST imported rules into the database.

Pass ``lawId`` to link the imported personas/rules to a specific act so the
Simulator Rules page groups them under that act.
Dry-run parse of an AKN XML act — no persistence.

Parse an AKN XML act and PERSIST it as a Law (insert or update by slug).

The act's legal personas are also converted into simulator personas/rules
linked to this law, so its "Compliance Rules" show on the public law page.

put.description:
Replace an act's source XML. Re-parses the uploaded AKN document and
updates this act in place — the act's id/slug are preserved even if the new
XML's title differs — refreshing sections, penalties, personas, amendments,
relationships and the stored source XML that the download serves.

ActDetail.title: ActDetail
ActDetail.description:
The full admin detail view of an act. Built from a Law record; structures
the Law doesn't store (chapters/amendments/links) come back empty.

Mirrors the frontend `ActDetail` interface in src/types/law.ts.

ActImportResult.title: ActImportResult
ActImportResult.description:
Result of parsing (preview) or importing (commit) an Akoma Ntoso XML act.

Mirrors the frontend `ImportResult` interface in ImportActView.tsx.

ActSummary.title: ActSummary
ActSummary.description:
A law exposed as a summary for the admin Acts listing.

An "act" is a Law record; this is the subset of fields the Acts table shows.
Mirrors the frontend `ActSummary` interface in src/types/law.ts.

AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description:
Identity + resolved RBAC context, returned by /auth/me.

``permissions`` is the user's *effective* permission set (role permissions
plus any direct grants), which the frontend uses to build the dynamic
sidebar and gate actions.

ImportPreview.title: ImportPreview
ImportPreview.description: Result of parsing+merging an uploaded rules spreadsheet, without committing.

LawCreate.title: LawCreate
LawCreate.description:
Payload for the admin 'Add Law' form (ports lawBuilder.LawDraft).

`id`/`apiSlug` are derived server-side from title + year.

SimulateRequest.title: SimulateRequest
SimulateRequest.description:
Evaluate a set of applicable rules against checked checklist items.

`checkedKeys` use the same format as the frontend's itemKey():
"<ruleId>::action::<index>" or "<ruleId>::artifact::<index>".
